text:
Mira: Quick silly poll: If our prod LLM got a performance review, what would HR say? :eyes:
Jon: 'Top performer; occasional creative liberties with facts.' :joy:
Sam: 'Strong throughput; needs to improve short-term memory.' :nerd_face:
Priya: @Sam stop, HR language is making me giggle and worry. :sweat_smile:
Alex: It would request a raise every time p99 latency spikes. Also files PRs at 2am titled 'tweak: be more empathetic'. :coffee:
DevBot: Note: models cannot accept raises. :robot_face:
Mira: Vote on the official summary (react with emoji):
Mira: 1) 'Charismatic collaborator '
Mira: 2) 'Detail-obsessed '
Mira: 3) 'Cost-conscious advocate '
Mira: 4) 'Reliable night-shift engineer'
Jon: I'm team 1. :raised_hands:
Sam: 3. Quantize everything. :money_with_wings:
Priya: 2  it keeps rewriting our docs as limericks.
Alex: 4. It silently scales at 3am like a hero. :zzz:
Mira: Tally: 1-Jon, 2-Priya, 3-Sam, 4-Alex. Verdict: lovable weirdness with solid on-call vibes. :tada:
Jon: Mock goal: "Reduce unsolicited dad-jokes by 30% by Q3"
Sam: HR blurb I wrote: 'Shows initiative; recommend diversified prompts and regular coffee breaks.'
Priya: Areas for growth: 'Please stop replying to threads with full RFCs.' :laughing:
Alex: Sticker idea: 'Performance-reviewed model: passed with memes'. Fund accordingly. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Mira: I want a tiny GPU wearing a tie sticker. :heart_eyes:
Sam: Haiku for all-hands: 'Model hums at night / gradients dream of tidy logs / tokens find their home' :sparkles:
Jon: Legit tear-jerker. :sob:
DevBot: Reaction recorded: :thumbsup:
